about: A routine moved from another app is saved as a cron line (Fridays at 16:00 in this computer's zone). It is made through the routines route, then opened in Pepper's panel, Edit, When, Every week.

steps.eval: (async () => { const { bots } = await (await fetch('/api/bots')).json(); const pepper = bots.find((bot) => bot.name === 'Pepper'); await fetch('/api/routines', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'Friday promises', prompt: 'List every open promise, oldest first.', botId: pepper.id, enabled: true, schedule: { type: 'cron', expression: '0 16 * * 5', timeZone: Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone } }) }); return true; })()
